spans.text: The Court of Decay are a well-organized cult of necromancers who revere undeath. They are led by particularly powerful undead and those who control undead in service to their lord - the god of undeath, Gotham. The Court is well-funded, managing to lure many into its ranks who are among the wealthiest in society: those who fear the death their fortunes cannot protect them from. Similarly, shorter-lived races find themselves drawn to the cult’s promises. Their primary goal has always been two-fold: restore Gotham to a body on this side of the Divine Curtain, and spread undeath across the world to create a utopia they can rule by their god’s side.
